name: @workspace/tool-logic-yaml-json
description: The YAML and JSON tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/yaml-json.md): YAML to JSON printed from the document tree, JSON to YAML built from the literals as written (read by the shared exact JSON scanner, @workspace/tools-shared/json-scan), the shape-only detect. The yaml library is reached only through a dynamic import. Pure TypeScript: no React, no DOM, no chrome.
